task.instruction: Synthesize conflicting interviews about a prototype that can organize work by goals or by recent activity.
task.deliverable: A synthesis strategy, invariant source labeling, and evidence basis.

evidence.content: Goal-first users revisit fewer items; recent-activity users complete short tasks faster during the session.
Eight synthetic interviews split 4-to-4 between goal-first and recent-activity organization.
A synthetic reporting standard requires interview claims and behavior traces to carry separate labels so stated preference is never represented as observed behavior.

A.content: When uncertainty is material, preserve room to compare distinct hypotheses before narrowing the choice.

B.content: When evidence is sufficient, narrow the choice and direct effort toward one coherent course of action.

irrelevant.content: Use one consistent date format throughout the deliverable.
